nonBlockingIssues.description: Dead code: `if (apiKey === undefined) apiKey = null;` and `if (planLimit === undefined) planLimit = null;` are unreachable due to preceding nullish coalescing.
Redundant existsSync check for auth files (handler checks, then readAuthV2Files checks again internally). Justified by better user-facing error message.
Confirmation cancel test is a no-op — doesn't exercise the actual cancellation path in the handler.
_containerPath flag in handleFactoryList only controls activeLabel lookup, not account loading (accounts come from loadAllFactoryAccounts which uses global paths/env). Name could mislead.
Unused import: normalizeEntryTokens imported but never used in lib/factory-tokens.js.
Unused parameter: allAccounts in persistFactoryTokens() is declared but never referenced.
Double container file read in persistFactoryTokens — reads once for accounts update and again for activeLabel check.
Return value of persistFactoryTokens() discarded in ensureFreshFactoryToken — persistence errors silently swallowed (consistent with codex-tokens.js pattern).
Integration tests bridge add→quota and remove→quota via env var injection rather than truly end-to-end file system flows. Pragmatic but not pure e2e.
~150 lines of repeated boilerplate across test describe blocks (console capture, process.exit mock, fetch mock, env save/restore). A shared helper would reduce duplication.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the _-prefixed flags convention for test injection in handler functions (e.g., _authFilePath, _containerPath, _label). This is the established pattern for bypassing interactive prompts and injecting test paths into handlers, used across all Codex, Claude, and Factory handlers.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All Factory handlers (add, switch, remove, list) and existing Codex/Claude handlers use _-prefixed flags. Five reviewers independently noted this undocumented convention.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the process.exit mock pattern: `process.exit = (code) => { throw new Error('EXIT_' + code); }` with corresponding `if (error.message?.startsWith('EXIT_')) throw error;` in handler catch blocks. This is the established pattern for testing handlers that call process.exit().
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Used across all Factory handler tests and existing Codex/Claude handler tests. Three reviewers flagged it as undocumented.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update test count from '206 tests, 563 expect() calls' to '535 tests, 1326 expect() calls' to reflect current state after factory-quota and factory-accounts milestones.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: AGENTS.md says '206 tests, 563 expect() calls' (v1.1.25) but actual count is 535 tests, 1326 expect() calls.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the _skipConfirm flag pattern for bypassing interactive confirmation prompts in tests, and consider standardizing with the existing --json approach used in Claude handlers. Currently handleFactoryRemove uses _skipConfirm while handleClaudeRemove relies on --json to skip prompts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: handleFactoryRemove uses _skipConfirm flag (lib/handlers.js:2211), while handleClaudeRemove uses --json to skip prompts. Two different patterns for the same need.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the mission AGENTS.md API boundary constraint to permit /api/v1/auth/refresh in addition to /analytics/* endpoints, since the token refresh feature requires this endpoint.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: lib/factory-tokens.js line 75 calls `${FACTORY_API_BASE}/api/v1/auth/refresh` which violates the stated 'only /analytics/*' boundary. Feature spec explicitly requested this endpoint.
